title: Mask Adoption Behavior Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and wear face masks over time under social influence, information campaigns, policies, and market constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals observe mask-wearing in their social network and update attitudes and wearing probability toward perceived norms.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Household-level norms influence members’ mask attitudes and stock sharing.

interactions.name: policy_compliance
interactions.description: Policies (recommendations or mandates) change individuals’ wearing decisions depending on compliance propensity and enforcement intensity.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks subject to retailer price, inventory, and rationing; successful purchases increase personal/household stock.

interactions.name: media_influence
interactions.description: Media sources broadcast messages that affect risk perception, trust, and mask attitudes, including potential misinformation.

interactions.name: location_access_control
interactions.description: Locations with requirements may deny entry or penalize non-wearers; enforcement modifies behavior via fines or refusal of service.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days until mask adoption reaches a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: peak_adoption_level
metrics.description: Maximum daily adoption rate achieved during the simulation.

metrics.name: policy_effect_on_adoption
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate attributable to policy activation or enforcement intensity changes.

metrics.name: campaign_effect_on_attitudes
metrics.description: Shift in average mask attitude following information campaigns.

metrics.name: supply_demand_gap
metrics.description: Difference between mask demand and available inventory over time.

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_by_group
metrics.description: Adoption rate differences across demographic or income groups.

metrics.name: noncompliance_events
metrics.description: Count of instances where individuals attempt to access locations without masks when required.
